description: The main window: the app's own commands, logging, reading the launch deep link, and the frameless-window chrome (ADR 0028). Least privilege: no fs, shell, http, opener or dialog from the webview (the Rust side opens links, files and dialogs through its own checked commands). Window permissions are limited to what the custom title bar needs; creating webviews is limited to the Social window, whose label is checked by the social capability.
